title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Execution Preview MCP Tool Implementation v0.1
objective: Use TDD and the test pyramid to implement only the additive preview_repair_execution MCP tool by reusing the package-owned dry-run repair execution runner, enforcing exactly one of non-empty taskIds or all true, never accepting validation-only mode, and preserving bounded output, redaction, maintainer review, verification, installed-consumer, and no-target-write boundaries from ADR-0024.
acceptance: Preserve all nine existing MCP tools unchanged and add only preview_repair_execution.
Reuse the package-owned dry-run repair execution runner without duplicating domain logic.
Require packagePath and exactly one of non-empty taskIds or all true; support optional outputDir.
Never accept or execute validation-only mode or arbitrary commands.
Return only reportPath, markdownPath, taskCount, and status as bounded structured output.
Declare readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint false, and openWorldHint false.
Prove fail-closed errors, text and structured redaction, real tools/list and tools/call, installed consumer compatibility, and no target repository writes.
Keep patch-plan MCP, evidence-package MCP, resources, prompts, automatic patch application, publication, and deployment outside this Goal.
